name: review-code
description: Code review skill whose findings carry file:line evidence and an evidence class.

finder_model.title: Finder model
finder_model.description: Model for the finder lane: opus, sonnet, haiku, fable or a full model ID. Leave empty for the tier's value.

standards_model.title: Standards model
standards_model.description: Model for the Standards lane: opus, sonnet, haiku, fable or a full model ID. Leave empty to use the finder model.

standards_effort.title: Standards effort
standards_effort.description: Effort for the Standards lane. Levels: low, medium, high, xhigh, max. Leave empty to use the finder effort.

verifier_model.title: Verifier model
verifier_model.description: Model for the verifier lane: opus, sonnet, haiku, fable or a full model ID. Leave empty for the tier's value.

default_tier.title: Default tier
default_tier.description: Tier used when no --tier flag is given: quick, standard or deep. The lean tier is available only as the --lean flag.

finder_effort.title: Finder effort
finder_effort.description: Effort for every finder lane. Levels: low, medium, high, xhigh, max. Leave empty for the tier's value.

verifier_effort.title: Verifier effort
verifier_effort.description: Effort for the verifier lanes. Levels: low, medium, high, xhigh, max. Leave empty for the tier's value.

max_packs.title: Max packs
max_packs.description: Cap on packs per run, 1 to 9. Leave empty for the tier's value.

agent_prefix.title: Agent prefix
agent_prefix.description: Plugin name whose agents run the lanes, as <prefix>:finder and so on. Leave empty for review-code. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, at most 64.

nav_hint.title: Navigation hint
nav_hint.description: One line telling the lanes which code-navigation tools to prefer, at most 300 characters. A preference, not a permission. Leave empty for none.
